behavior_change_from_previous: a minor release on 0.34.1 for a recorded login into the operator's folder: karvi login --record=PATH records into PATH itself, with no day folder, PATH and its parents created when absent, as <device>.log beside <device>.meta.jsonl; when either name is taken both take the session's start, <device>-YYMMDD-HHMMSS, and when either of those is taken too the login is refused transcript_name_taken (exit 111) and nothing is written; a bare --record keeps transcript.root's day folder and <device>-HHMMSS; transcript_path_not_directory reads --record=PATH; name a folder; every counter is 0.34.1's (configuration schema 6, registry 31, execution plan 14, daemon IPC 12, command record 4, job manifest and summary 5, plan report 3, credential package 2, scoreboard 4, audit 2), and the module graph and Go are 0.34.1's; the first submission after the upgrade drains a 0.34.1 daemon; see CHANGELOG.md

build.dependencies: vendored (go.mod, go.sum, vendor/); built with no network

daemon_upgrade_recovery.job_submission_schema: exact-current-only (the client's IPC schema and build)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.automatic_replacement: a client launching its own daemon (daemon.launch client) drains a daemon of another build at its own schema: idle, it exits and the client starts its own in the same invocation; busy, it finishes its jobs and exits after the last, each submission meanwhile refused daemon_draining (exit 112); a service account's daemon (daemon.launch systemd) is never drained by a client, and its unit is restarted
daemon_upgrade_recovery.incompatible_run_error: daemon_incompatible (a daemon of a newer IPC schema); daemon_draining (a drained daemon finishing its jobs)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.actual_lifecycle_replay: not run: the newest release whose daemon IPC schema (11) differs from this client's (12) is v0.29.0, whose daemon predates the drain that exits and listens on daemon.sock, which this client never reaches; the compatibility example ran before the number was committed: beside the released v0.34.1 daemon, at this client's schema and of another build, the client's daemon status stacked the two builds (compatible: false), its run's exercise drained the idle daemon and started its own (exit 0, no device contacted), and with the older daemon holding a job on the fake device the client's run was refused daemon_draining (exit 112), the daemon exiting after the job (evidence/ipc-schema-compat.log)
